name: revcontent-mcp
description: Revcontent (ads): me, list_accounts, list_campaigns, get_report, update_budget, pause_resume. Every

platform_mcp_revcontent_client_id.title: PLATFORM_MCP_REVCONTENT_CLIENT_ID
platform_mcp_revcontent_client_id.description: client_id under Account Settings > 'Stats API Credentials' (API access is enabled by your Revcontent representative).

platform_mcp_revcontent_client_secret.title: PLATFORM_MCP_REVCONTENT_CLIENT_SECRET
platform_mcp_revcontent_client_secret.description: client_secret from the same section; access tokens last 24 hours and are re-requested automatically.

tools.name: me
tools.description: GET /stats/api/v1.0/boosts?limit=1: confirms the Stats API credentials (Revcontent has no who-am-i call).

tools.name: list_accounts
tools.description: GET /stats/api/v1.0/sub_accounts/list_accounts: the sub accounts of the credential's account (user_id, email, status, permissions); the main account itself is not listed.

tools.name: list_campaigns
tools.description: GET /stats/api/v1.0/boosts (limit/offset; `status` filters the user status `enabled`: active or inactive). Campaigns of the credential's own account (account_id is not sent). `budget` is the daily budget in USD as a string (or 'unlimited'); raw.status is the system status and raw carries month-to-date cost, clicks and impressions.

tools.name: get_report
tools.description: GET /stats/api/v1.0/boosts/performance?date_from&date_to[&boost_id]: daily rows for one campaign, or aggregated over all campaigns when campaign_id is omitted. Values are strings; cost is USD.

tools.name: update_budget
tools.description: POST /stats/api/v1.0/boosts/{id}/settings {budget_type: daily, budget_amount}: daily budget in USD, minimum 50 (`currency` is ignored); spends money. Pacing defaults to on for daily budgets.

tools.name: pause_resume
tools.description: POST /stats/api/v1.0/boosts {id, enabled: off|on}. Resuming restarts spending.
